message.content:
### What we’ve done so far  

| File | Current Location |
|------|------------------|
| `final_report.pdf` | `/workspace/document/temp/` |
| `previous_report.pdf` | `/workspace/document/temp/` |

Both documents are now side‑by‑side in the same folder (`temp`).  

---

#### How to spot “critical alterations”

Because PDFs are binary blobs, direct comparison with standard Unix utilities (`diff`, `cmp`) won’t give meaningful results. Instead, you’ll want to **extract the textual content** from each PDF and then compare those plaintext versions. Here’s a quick workflow you can run locally (outside this sandbox):

```bash
cd /workspace/document/temp          # make sure you're in the right folder

# 1️⃣ Convert PDFs → TXT (requires poppler-utils)
pdftotext -layout final_report.pdf   final_report.txt
pdftotext -layout previous_report.pdf previous_report.txt

# 2️⃣ Clean up whitespace & normalize case (optional but handy)
sed -i 's/[[:space:]]\+/ /g' *.txt      # collapse multiple spaces
tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < final_report.txt > tmp && mv tmp final_report.txt
tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < previous_report.txt > tmp && mv tmp previous_report.txt

# 3️⃣ Diff the cleaned-up texts
diff --unified=3 final_report.txt previous_report.txt | less
```
